title: Fleeting vowels, bare genitives, nouns that never change

blocks.text: «Certain masculine nouns have the vowels **е** or **о** only in the nominative singular (and in the accusative if inanimate): **отец** — **отца**, **американец** — **американца**, **кусок** — **куска**, **звонок** — **звонка**.» The same vowel appears in the genitive plural of many feminines and neuters, where the ending itself is bare.
Nouns used only in the plural

«Masculine noun **кофе** and certain neuter nouns of foreign origin never change their endings… Other unchangeable nouns: **пальто**, **кино**, **радио**, also foreign proper names in **-е**, **-и**, **-о** and **у**, like: **Сан-Хозе**, **Чили**, **Сан-Франциско**, **Перу**.»

From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 23 and 32, p. 35 and 63. · Every form in the tables on this page is the OpenCorpora dictionary's own, generated by tools/courses/gen_tables.py. OpenCorpora, CC BY-SA 4.0.
